title: RP_Master_thesis
summary: Notebook-based code from a master thesis (by Romain Palazzo, under the DAI-Lab organization) that generates synthetic tabular data and reviews synthetic-data quality metrics. The notebooks import sdv.tabular's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN and TVAE synthesizers to generate synthetic data, and separately import sdmetrics to benchmark table-level quality metrics.
